content:
Completed in 35 days

Louise turned to Quick Sell Your House because she had grown frustrated by the length of time it was taking to sell her property through a regular estate agent, following separation from her partner.

Unfortunately, on the open market, mortgage difficulties and chain delays make sale timescales unpredictable and sales often fall through. This leaves people searching for a new buyer and starting the selling process again. In fact, believe it or not, Louise’s property had been marketed for nearly three years without luck.

Louise decided that enough was enough and so looked for other alternatives that, while offering less than they originally hoped for, would guarantee a sale. So she could make a clean break and move on with her life.
